name: buy_plugin
description: Get the store link for a plugin found in the marketplace (see list_store_plugins) that the customer doesn't already hold a license for. Only call this after the customer has explicitly agreed to buy it -- never speculatively. For security reasons, purchases happen on the web, not through this assistant -- this tool does not complete a purchase or make the plugin installable; it returns a `purchase_url` for the customer to finish buying it themselves.

name.description: The plugin's exact display `name`, from list_store_plugins -- used to build the customer-facing link text without a separate lookup.
